details: Listen and point checks understanding of word meaning and sound as students match what they hear to the right image. It also strengthens first-sound awareness by isolating the target sounds before giving examples of words beginning with those sounds.
Look for  careful listening, correct pointing to the target words as they are heard and active participation.

lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p21 - Colour around the pictures to match

details: Colour around the pictures to match further strengthens first-sound awareness. It demonstrates early phonics control by linking each letter sound to the picture that begins with it. It also helps students improve their fine motor skills by colouring carefully around the pictures.
Look for accurate identification of the matching letter and sound, correct isolation of the first sound of each picture, and neat colouring within the lines.
